speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To better understand your condition, how many weeks pregnant are you, and have you noticed any rash, joint pain, or vision changes?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that information. Did you consume raw milk, unpasteurized cheese, or soft cheeses made from unpasteurized milk recently? This is crucial to rule out Listeria or Brucella infection.
